tokyo-kanto-rides-mount-haruna-and-ikaho.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: This High point near Sagamihara → Near Kokubunji stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Scenic stretch in Ageoshimo → Photo stop near Satte is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

sections.to: Near Ōami, on the way back
sections.advice: Photo stop near Satte → Near Ōami, on the way back can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

sections.from: Near Ōami, on the way back

sections.advice: Food stop near Kisarazu → Back to Mount Haruna is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.
